blocks.text: West Central homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

West Central, September 2026. Detached houses: 66 listed at month end and 2 sold in September, a sales ratio of 3% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 78 listed at month end and 10 sold in September, a sales ratio of 13% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, detached houses sold 16 over 4 months against an average of 63.0 listed, about 15.8 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 8 sold. condos and townhomes sold 45 over 4 months against an average of 83.0 listed, about 7.4 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 20 sold.
